conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 2 pass / 5 fail.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: scenario cards expose proper button semantics with aria-pressed and the DAW recommendation (512/1024 hint with trade-offs) rendered; zero console errors; references block missing.
